Bound-only positive path: a healthy worker's agent_start follows the acknowledgement within milliseconds, so the rig positive path shows the commit at the moment the turn started but cannot by itself distinguish commit-on-ack from commit-on-start; the negative control and the unit/e2e red-green runs are what prove the new ordering.
